stop_rules.observation: No safe durable transformation-active curvature reached before approved NiTi, sleeve, fixture or temperature limit
stop_rules.scientific_interpretation: The selected apparatus cannot access the phase-active domain under current bounds
stop_rules.route_condition_or_action: STOP_MP1_COUPLING_CORE only if tested safe envelope demonstrably covers the intended MP1 configuration; otherwise select larger wire/prestrain or different fixture only after new safety review.

stop_rules.observation: Transformation-supported interval exists but corrected interwire slip is absent or below detectability throughout the safe pressure-curvature domain
stop_rules.scientific_interpretation: Coexistence not demonstrated; distinguish physical no-slip from insufficient slip resolution
stop_rules.route_condition_or_action: Improve slip channel or change a prespecified pressure level/packing within approved bounds; stop core if coverage and observability are established and no coexistence remains.

stop_rules.observation: Validated slip exists but batch-calibrated transformation signature cannot be activated in the same safe domain
stop_rules.scientific_interpretation: The selected wire/curvature/prestrain state supports slip only
stop_rules.route_condition_or_action: If strain/thermal access covers the intended configuration, stop coupling core; otherwise change approved specimen geometry and repeat as a new pilot.

stop_rules.observation: Sealed channels cannot independently separate slip from transformation after controls and uncertainty propagation
stop_rules.scientific_interpretation: Mechanism attribution is not feasible from this apparatus; global loops are non-identifying
stop_rules.route_condition_or_action: Change channel/optical path or narrow objective to predictive H0b validity; do not claim coexistence.

stop_rules.observation: Markers, sensors, leads or feedthrough change packing/contact/slip threshold beyond the predeclared perturbation budget or cause leakage
stop_rules.scientific_interpretation: Observed behavior belongs to the instrumented specimen, not the intended baseline
stop_rules.route_condition_or_action: Use lower-intrusion channel and rerun marked/unmarked comparison; unquantified perturbation prevents passage.

stop_rules.observation: Slow/fast or dwell comparison shows temperature/rate/history effects could account for putative mechanism separation
stop_rules.route_condition_or_action: Require THERMOMECHANICAL_H0b_REQUIRED before later model lock, or restrict rate/temperature domain if independently justified.

stop_rules.observation: Leak, pressure overshoot, membrane damage, NiTi wire damage/residual set, uncontrolled fixture slip, or other approved safety limit
stop_rules.scientific_interpretation: Specimen integrity or operator safety fails; data after event invalid
stop_rules.route_condition_or_action: Stop loading immediately per lab procedure; human safety review and new specimen/limits required before restart.

pass_criteria.criterion: Repeatable sealed operation across selected pressure-curvature path; leak and pressure records accepted
Accessible and durable p-kappa-T operating domain within predeclared wire, membrane, fixture and cycle-integrity limits
Corrected direct or independently validated proxy evidence of relative interwire slip, separated from clamp, membrane, rigid-body and elastic extension
Independent, batch-calibrated evidence supporting stress-induced NiTi transformation, with thermal and elastic/friction-only controls; evidence level declared direct or indirect
PASS-3 and PASS-4 occupy the same local operating/time interval after synchronization uncertainty, and recur in confirmation cycles
Each necessary channel has calibration, noise, synchronization, resolution and marker/feedthrough perturbation quantified
Temperature, rate and history are bounded relative to future discrimination margin or explicitly route to thermomechanical H0b
Post-pilot specimen integrity is acceptable for future independently designed validation; no puncture, damage or uncontrolled drift

logical_gate: All eight pass criteria require real physical data and human review. Analytical overlap estimates, sensor plans, or global hysteresis cannot satisfy them.
coverage_rule: A negative small-bundle result may stop the general MP1 coupling core only if the tested safe strain, pressure/contact, temperature, packing and boundary envelope is documented to bracket the intended actual bundle; otherwise NARROW or REDESIGN.
